title: Rapid isolation of anti-inflammatory Terpenoids from Dichroa febrifuga.
authors: Du, Ning-Ning; Xu, Zhi-Yong; Yang, Chun-Ying; Xin, Ben-Song; Zhang, Xin; Li, Ying-Shuang; Yao, Guo-Dong; Huang, Xiao-Xiao; Song, Shao-Jiang
one_liner_zh: 该文从常山分离抗炎萜类化合物，仅用分子对接验证化合物与NF-kB转录因子的结合亲和力，核心是天然产物化学与抗炎活性，蛋白质-DNA互作与AI/物理模拟方法深度不足。
abstract: Based on a structure-guided rapid isolation strategy, nine terpenoids were targeted and isolated from the traditional antimalarial herbal medicine Dichroa febrifuga Lour. These included four new compounds, one of which possessed a previously undescribed skeleton. The structures of all compounds were unequivocally established through extensive spectroscopic analysis, quantum chemical calculations, computer-assisted structure elucidation, and X-ray single-crystal diffraction. In the context of the dysregulated inflammatory responses often accompanying malaria infection, the isolated compounds were evaluated for their anti-inflammatory activities. Several compounds exhibited moderate anti-inflammatory activity. Molecular docking technology was employed to validate the binding affinities of the active compounds to the core inflammatory transcription factor NF-kappaB. Furthermore, network pharmacology analysis revealed that these compounds may exert synergistic effects by modulating multiple inflammation-related pathways.
abstract_zh: 基于结构引导的快速分离策略，从传统抗疟草药常山（Dichroa febrifuga Lour.）中靶向分离得到九种萜类化合物。其中包括四种新化合物，其中一种具有此前未描述过的骨架。所有化合物的结构通过广泛的光谱分析、量子化学计算、计算机辅助结构解析及X射线单晶衍射得以明确确定。鉴于疟疾感染常伴随的炎症反应失调，对分离得到的化合物进行了抗炎活性评估。数种化合物表现出中等抗炎活性。采用分子对接 (molecular docking) 技术验证了活性化合物与核心炎症转录因子NF-kappaB的结合亲和力。此外，网络药理学分析揭示，这些化合物可能通过调节多条炎症相关通路发挥协同作用。
